Name: Eemie's Bees
Author: Eemiestardew
Description:
IMPORTANT! Requires [url=http://canimod.com/for-players/install-smapi]SMAPI 1.14+[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D1255%26preview%3D&pUp=1]Custom Critters[/url] by spacechase0.

Hello! I love bees and[b] they are so important for the environment[/b]. It's a little sad they're not in the base game, considering you can have bee hives and such. This mod makes it so the bee houses/hives in your game have a chance of spawning little bees around it!

[u]How to install:
[/u]Unzip and copy paste the folder 'eemie.bee' into Mods\CustomCritters\Critters


[u]To adjust the settings:
[/u]Open 'critters.json' into a text editing program like notepad++.
Edit [color=#fce5cd][font=Courier New]"Chance": 0.90[/font],[/color] into something like [font=Courier New][color=#fce5cd]"Chance": 0.60,[/color] [/font][font=Arial]to decrease the chance of them spawning. [/font][font=Courier New][color=#fce5cd]0.90 [/color][/font][font=Arial]= 90% chance[/font][font=Arial] of  spawning 1 bee around a bee hive.
[/font]

[u]FAQ[/u]
[b][i]Help, my bees aren't spawning!
[/i][/b]Don't panic, it happens. Critters don't spawn everyday. There's a chance of them not spawning a couple of days in a row.

[b][i]Help, something broke!
[/i][/b]Please refer to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D1255%26preview%3D&pUp=1]spacechase0[/url] to report a bug (ha ha bees are bugs too) if you think you found one. I merely did the artwork and animation for the bees!

[b][i]When do the bees spawn?
[/i][/b]They spawn in spring, summer and fall and on sunny days. 

[b][i]Where can I find the mods that are shown in the gif?
[/i][/b]I made them, you can find them [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615/?tb=mods&pUp=1]here[/url].

[b][i]Help, I have a lot of money and I don't know what to do with it!
[/i][/b]That's great, maybe donate some of it to a charity to help bees?

[b][color=#ea9999]If you have money to spare, please consider donating to a charity that helps to save the bees!
[/color][/b]_______
